scenarios.title: Owner search
scenarios.assertion: A seeded owner can be found by last name.

scenarios.title: Owner validation
scenarios.assertion: Invalid required fields prevent saving an owner.

scenarios.title: Pet association
scenarios.assertion: A new pet appears under the selected owner.

scenarios.title: Visit association
scenarios.assertion: A visit is recorded against the selected pet.

scenarios.title: Persistence
scenarios.assertion: Saved values remain visible after navigation and reload.
